title: Host's father dreamed of an earthquake on January 17th before the Northridge quake

tellings.quote: in it he talks about how he would always dream of an earthquake on Jan January 17th

plain: Jesse Michels's father kept dreaming of an earthquake on January 17th, before the Northridge earthquake struck Los Angeles. Michels relays this from his father, who, Michels says, writes about it in the book The Tools. If true, the dreams would be a glimpse of an event before it happened.
